verdict.rationale: Leaving with your data is plausible but only implied. PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility means any Postgres client can read the data out, changefeeds stream changes with at-least-once delivery, and full/incremental backups exist. None of the evidence documents exporting a complete dataset into open, portable formats. missing for 10: a documented bulk export to open formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/SQL dump), stated formats for changefeed and backup output, evidence that backups can be restored outside CockroachDB, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a successful migration away.
